boundary: Operational and synthetic workflow evidence only; failed witnesses remain retained and same-owner passing witnesses are not independent reproduction.

records.failed_witness: One combined pretty projection of six source manifest and receipt documents exceeded the available model context and truncated before attributable completion.
records.passing_witness: All 71 source-to-evidence entries matched exact target Git blobs and byte counts, with zero path issue; source-to-final contained exactly 94 changed paths.

records.failed_witness: A PowerShell branch-existence probe placed a native command and LASTEXITCODE expression inside one parenthesized assignment and failed parser validation before Git ran.
records.passing_witness: The corrected probe proved the Sable path, local branch and remote branch were all absent before creation.
records.recovery: Run the native command first, capture LASTEXITCODE in a separate scalar and construct the summary object afterward.
records.recurrence_guard: Evaluate native commands before summary expressions and never embed command separators inside PowerShell parentheses.
records.rollback: The parser failure ran no Git command and changed no branch or filesystem state.
records.sibling_recommendation: Sequence native probes and scalar summaries explicitly.

records.rollback: No retry mutation was required; the incomplete wrapper attribution remains zero credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Inspect actual setup state before retrying any incomplete wrapper.

records.failed_witness: The large test-module apply-patch response exceeded the tool-output projection, so the acknowledgement was truncated and the resulting filesystem state was initially unknown.
records.passing_witness: The recovered inspection found the complete file, Python compilation succeeded, and the later bounded test run discovered all intended tests.
records.recovery: Inspect the exact path, byte and line counts, tail, and compilation state before considering any retry; the complete 297-line file was already present, so no duplicate patch was applied.
records.recurrence_guard: After any truncated patch acknowledgement, inspect exact filesystem state before retrying and split future edits into smaller exact hunks.
records.rollback: No rollback was required; the original edit was retained only after exact inspection and earned no test credit from its truncated acknowledgement.
records.sibling_recommendation: Treat truncated mutation responses as unknown state until path, size, tail, syntax, and diff are checked.

records.failed_witness: The first direct owner-test invocation compiled the test module but failed all execution credit before discovery because Python could not import the repository-local scripts package from the test-file launch context.
records.passing_witness: The recovered invocation passed 59 of 59 owner tests, including immutable x1 checks, fourteen positive fixtures, fourteen rejecting mutations, hardening boundaries, and Auren and Ilyra compatibility.
records.recovery: Resolve the repository root from the test file, prepend that exact root to sys.path before local imports, and rerun only the blocked owner-test component.
records.recurrence_guard: Bind directly executable repository test modules to Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] before importing repository-local packages.
records.rollback: The failed invocation changed no repository file and retains zero pass credit; the import guard is additive and owner-scoped.
records.sibling_recommendation: For direct Python test launches, establish the repository root before importing scripts or use an equivalent exact process-local import root.

records.failed_witness: The first phase-builder invocation rejected Sable's fourteen unique hardening callables because the inherited builder required the callable inventory to equal the ten runner-artifact rows exactly.
records.passing_witness: The recovered builder compiled, completed validly, generated sixty bounded phase files, retained all twenty-five startup and runtime methods, and materialized ten distinct runner contracts while all fourteen callable fixtures remained covered by the owner tests.
records.recovery: Require at least the frozen runner count, preserve uniqueness and nonempty-name checks across the full declared callable inventory, and bind the first ten declared callables deterministically to the ten runner artifacts while the owner tests continue covering all fourteen.
records.recurrence_guard: Distinguish the complete callable validation inventory from the minimum runner-artifact portfolio and map a deterministic declared prefix only after validating the full list.
records.rollback: The failed builder invocation exited before generating phase evidence and earned zero build credit; the compatibility change preserves exact predecessor inventories.
records.sibling_recommendation: Allow a phase profile to test more bounded callables than it materializes as runner artifacts, but require a unique deterministic runner subset.

records.failed_witness: The first valid builder output generated a short overview rather than a three-page-equivalent narrative and inherited a stale museum-object phrase into both the overview and static report.
records.passing_witness: The regenerated overview contains 2,153 words with zero stale museum-object hits; the report has one semantic article, thirteen narrative headings, a captioned outcome table, and the complete 59-test owner selection passed.
records.recovery: Make the family-current overview consume the immutable phase charter, render source, identity, focus, proposal, pillar, source, threat, accessibility, reproduction, negative, and terminal sections, and convert the narrative into semantic HTML headings and paragraphs.
records.recurrence_guard: Bind generated narrative to current immutable charter fields and inspect stale practice labels and document length before staging.
records.rollback: The first generated packet remained untracked and received zero evidence credit; regeneration is deterministic and owner-scoped.
records.sibling_recommendation: Audit generated narrative for phase-specific practice labels and the declared page-equivalent floor before evidence staging.

records.failed_witness: The first large overview-builder replacement failed exact-context verification at the retained-witness paragraph and applied no file change.
records.passing_witness: The split exact edits compiled, regenerated the synchronized packet, removed the stale label, produced the three-page-equivalent overview and semantic report, and preserved the complete 59-test pass.
records.recovery: Reinspect the exact live function and split the edit into a signature-and-context hunk, an exact return-body replacement, a call-site hunk, and a separate semantic-HTML hunk.
records.recurrence_guard: Split long template changes into exact function, call-site, and renderer patches after reading the live source.
records.rollback: The failed patch was atomic, changed no file, and earned zero implementation credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: For long generator templates, patch small independently verifiable surfaces rather than one broad context block.

records.failed_witness: The first smoke-use review found that the generic positional runner mapping bound the fourteen-callable Sable inventory to ten frozen runner descriptions without preserving their semantic groupings.
records.passing_witness: The regenerated contracts bind nine semantically matched representative validators plus the actual Sable hardening aggregate; the exact binding assertion and complete 60-test owner selection passed.
records.recovery: Bind nine semantically matched representative validators to the first nine runner surfaces and bind the tenth surface to the actual Sable hardening aggregate while retaining owner tests over all fourteen validators.
records.recurrence_guard: Validate runner identifiers, descriptions, callables, smoke tests, and aggregate intent together before claiming execution credit.
records.rollback: The mismatched contracts were untracked builder output and received zero evidence credit; no predecessor artifact or sibling lane was changed.
records.sibling_recommendation: Do not infer runner-contract truth from file count alone; inspect semantic binding and execute the declared callable.

records.failed_witness: The first combined exact staged-review wrapper spawned per-path Git processes and exceeded its thirty-second envelope before returning attributable output.
records.passing_witness: The bounded recovery inspected exactly sixty-four staged paths, parsed forty-one strict staged JSON blobs, scanned sixty-four staged text blobs with zero privacy candidates, scanned three staged Python blobs with zero bounded security findings, found zero x1 or out-of-scope paths, matched supported modes, and passed diff hygiene with no unstaged change.
records.recovery: Read the staged path set once, read the complete index once, drain one git cat-file batch process through communicate, parse exact blob framing in memory, and then run diff hygiene and unstaged-state checks separately.
records.recurrence_guard: Use one index read and one fully drained batch-object process for exact staged blob review rather than spawning Git once per path.
records.rollback: The timeout performed read-only staged inspection, changed no index or worktree state, and earned zero review credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use batched Git object reads for medium owner deltas and preserve any timed-out wrapper as a failed witness.

records.failed_witness: The first combined final consistency projection exceeded the available model-output context and returned no attributable aggregate result.
records.passing_witness: The separated recovery parsed all seventy then-current JSON documents with zero issue or valid:false receipt, scanned ninety-one text files across five privacy classes with zero candidate, kept ninety-one owner files and all twenty-one prose documents within their ceilings, adjudicated stale-practice matches as immutable provenance or retained-failure text, synchronized every terminal count mirror, and passed staged and unstaged diff hygiene.
records.recovery: Run strict JSON and valid-field review, five-class privacy review, count-mirror review, document-length and owner-file review, stale-label review, and diff hygiene as separate bounded scalar probes, then promote only after every required component passes.
records.recurrence_guard: Keep final consistency components independently attributable and project only scalar counts plus exact issue paths rather than one broad wrapper payload.
records.rollback: The truncated projection was read-only, changed no index, worktree file, Git object, or receipt, and retains zero validation credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Split final consistency checks by evidence class and retain any output-context truncation as a failed witness even when later components pass.

records.failed_witness: The first separated strict-JSON probe used a PowerShell here-string pipeline that exited without emitting an attributable result.
records.passing_witness: The recovered scalar-bound probe parsed all seventy then-current phase JSON documents with duplicate-key rejection, strict UTF-8 decoding, zero parse issues, and zero top-level valid:false receipts.
records.recovery: Bind the complete read-only Python program to one scalar argument, invoke python with that exact argument, and require a compact JSON summary containing parse and valid-field counts.
records.recurrence_guard: For multiline read-only Python probes in Windows PowerShell, pass one explicitly bound code scalar to python -c and require a machine-readable result object.
records.rollback: The silent probe was read-only, wrote no file, changed no index or Git object, and retains zero JSON-validation credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Treat a zero-output validation wrapper as failed even when its process exit appears successful; require an attributable result payload.

records.failed_witness: The first final document-ceiling and baton-integrity probe used an ad-hoc regex word tokenizer that disagreed with the phase builder's declared baton word metric and therefore returned valid:false.
records.passing_witness: The metric-bound recovery independently passed the 91-of-2,000 owner-file ceiling, all twenty-one document ceilings, and exact prepared-baton parity at 37,574 words, 287,526 bytes, and SHA-256 8268b0c4ea87a9912d876debc5a581566ef5c18a5e9d57a06e3127c837b7b5d9.
records.recovery: Inspect the builder's exact word-count implementation, recompute the baton with that same declared metric, and report byte and SHA-256 parity as separate scalars so a metric mismatch cannot hide passing ceiling checks.
records.recurrence_guard: Bind integrity probes to the producing tool's explicit metric definition and keep word, byte, digest, file-ceiling, and document-ceiling predicates separately attributable.
records.rollback: The failed probe was read-only, changed no file, index, Git object, or metadata receipt, and retains zero document or baton-integrity credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Reuse the producer's word metric rather than an ad-hoc tokenizer when validating a committed count receipt.

records.recovery: Locate the exact occurrence, distinguish a live count mirror from retained historical evidence, correct only a live mirror or explicitly classify immutable history, and rerun the bounded count-mirror predicate.

records.sibling_recommendation: A scalar stale-count failure still requires exact path adjudication; never mass-rewrite historical evidence merely to remove a number.

records.failed_witness: The second stale-count probe still scanned the complete packet and returned valid:false because retained Method Flow text deliberately quoted historical terminal counts as part of the preceding false-positive witness.
records.passing_witness: The narrowed recovery found exactly three old-number hits, all confined to the retained X011 witness in the operational ledger, consolidated ledger, and generated baton; zero unexpected live-mirror path remained, and every authoritative structured mirror plus the current closeout statement agreed.
records.recovery: Validate numeric values through the authoritative structured mirror fields and current closeout summaries, then classify old numbers inside retained Method Flow and the generated baton as immutable failure history rather than live mirrors.
records.recurrence_guard: Exclude retained-witness prose from stale-live-mirror absence assertions and validate live counts through exact schema paths plus current-summary assertions.
records.rollback: The overbroad scan was read-only, changed no packet, index, Git object, or receipt, and retains zero stale-label validation credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Do not make retained negative evidence fail merely because it truthfully names an earlier value; separate current mirrors from historical witness text.

records.failed_witness: The first literal final-staging preflight assumed thirty-three changed phase paths, discovered thirty-four, and stopped before git add.
records.passing_witness: The recovered staging pass reviewed twelve tracked updates and twenty-two intended lifecycle additions, proved all thirty-four paths were inside the Sable phase, staged the exact materialized array, and ended with thirty-four staged paths and zero unstaged path.
records.recovery: Enumerate the exact tracked and untracked path sets, inspect the additional path by name, validate every path against the owner-phase prefix and intended lifecycle allowlist, and stage only the verified materialized array without a guessed cardinality.
records.recurrence_guard: Derive staged-path cardinality from the exact reviewed path set and treat expected counts as assertions only after enumeration.
records.rollback: The preflight exited before git add, changed no index or worktree file, and retains zero staged-review credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Do not bind a staging mutation to a hand-counted cardinality; enumerate, review, then assert the observed literal set.

records.failed_witness: The first self-excluding receipt preflight expected the new untracked receipt to appear in git diff --name-only, observed zero unstaged tracked paths, and stopped before staging.
records.passing_witness: The recovered preflight found exactly the final staged-review receipt in the untracked set and exactly the operational ledger in the tracked working diff, parsed and privacy-scanned the 1,517-byte receipt successfully, staged both reviewed paths, and ended with thirty-five staged paths plus zero tracked or untracked residue.
records.recovery: Query the exact untracked-file set separately, require it to contain only the final staged-review receipt, validate that receipt strictly and for five-class privacy, then stage it and verify the complete index plus empty tracked and untracked residue.
records.recurrence_guard: Keep tracked working-tree diffs and untracked-file discovery as separate Git domains during precommit review.
